mapper.select: select m.model_code as modelCode, m.model_name as modelName, m.model_type as modelType from model_group_models mgm join models m on m.id = mgm.model_id where mgm.group_id = #{groupId} and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' group by m.model_code, m.model_name, m.model_type order by max(m.id) desc
